E2426

Function value does not satisfy `fn() Never`.

What

Function value does not satisfy `fn() Never`.

Why

`fn() Never` promises the callable never completes, so a returning function has the wrong contract (D-NEVER2=B).

Fix

Pass a function declared `Never`, or change the expected function type.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2426: tests/ui/never_return_fn_value.stderr.
